title: Prove analytic A2 rank-six capacity and equality
body:
## Summary

```diff
- A2 rank-six joint 32 and its 127-hyperplane table proved by finite support-space checks
+ Signed quadratic proof, outside-span 30, and exact 27-space equality classification
```

Add `research/e8-a2-analytic-rank6`. For every 27-root A2 fiber A and arbitrary ambient binary space V of dimension at most six, total root support plus singleton support is at most 32. Outside span(A) the bound is 30. Equality 32 holds exactly for a contained six-space with balanced affine section avoiding the fiber's unique missing root. The proof derives all 127 hyperplane counts and exactly27 equality spaces for each A. A 16-label witness attains32 on the fixed P112.

PR3262 owns the original 32/table result. This contribution replaces its finite capacity proof dependency by an analytic argument based on PR3280/3269. Exact predecessor proof bytes are retained and authenticated. Credit Nick Petalas, David Arias's quadratic model, DreamingOfClouds and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. Concurrent mixed 5/5/6 cut 40 and D6 capacity 18 work has separate hypotheses and is unused.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003988).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3262's capacity 32/table used127-hyperplane and 2,667-space finite checks. **After:** PROOF.md derives them from signed affine quadratic sums, with exact equality conditions. Finite replay binds all 3,360 fibers from 1,120 A2 planes to the required positive affine-six model.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, separate dense root/label reconstruction, canonical 127-hyperplane/witness check and 15 optimized source/hypothesis controls pass. Ruff and formatting pass.
- The designated read-only peer inspected actual proof/code/source/export and reran all three scripts under optimized Python 3.12. Exact REVIEW.json records 12 reviewed hashes, source equality and limits. Every reviewed scientific/source byte is unchanged; publication adds only that receipt.
- All13 final committed-byte/export checks and all three actual final read-only Git-free optimized CPython 3.13.16 commands pass.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py   --package research/e8-a2-analytic-rank6
```

Outside-span30 sharpness, simultaneous equality realizability, code-plane normalization, literal callers and shortening thresholds are unclaimed. No full C5, physical/restoration/consumer supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change. Historical flat censuses, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and human/proof-kernel approval are unrun. Open next questions are in README.md/TASK.json. Hosted CI is separate from these local checks.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only one new research package is added. Archival retention does not admit a supplier.
